items.title: Women's experience following orthodontic treatment with conventional fixed appliances and clear aligners: A qualitative study.
items.authors: San Nicolas Dubrull Lia Lucarelli N, Gonçalves Innocente G, Augusto Thiene Leme P, et al.
items.summary: This qualitative study aimed to explore the experiences of female patients following completion of orthodontic treatment with conventional fixed appliances and clear aligners. It used a clinical qualitative design with, semi-structured interviews featuring open-ended questions. Participants were recruited from private orthodontic practices, and the sample size was determined by data saturation. The final group included six patients treated with conventional fixed appliances and nine patients treated with clear aligners. items.summary: WUHAN, China: Growing evidence suggests that oral and gastro-intestinal diseases are interconnected, but the biological mechanisms underlying these associations are not well understood. items.title: Registration opens for 2027 CDS Midwinter Meeting
items.summary: CHICAGO, US: Registration has opened for the Chicago Dental Society (CDS) Midwinter Meeting, which will return to the McCormick Place West Building in Chicago from 25 to 27 February 2027. The meeting will feature an expanded scientific programme and introduce the Midwinter Meeting Digital Pass, which will provide access to recorded educational sessions.
